title: MOFA response to IPAC statement warning of threat of transnational repression by China
text:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) welcomes a statement made by the Inter-Parliamentary Alliance on China (IPAC) following its annual summit in The Hague on November 6.

The statement warned the international community about China’s growing foreign interference and transnational repression in democratic nations. Point six of the statement called on officials of democratic nations to expand formal engagement and public consultations with Taiwan’s government representatives, as well as pro-democracy dissidents, human rights defenders, and organizations representing diaspora minority groups. The governments and parliamentarians of democratic nations, the statement said, should proactively work to oppose China’s efforts to silence dissident voices.

The IPAC statement cited a report published by Safeguard Defenders entitled, “A Formula for Repression: China’s Global Grid for Community Control,” which was issued on November 6. This report pointed out that China was systematically exporting its surveillance and community control network globally. Such efforts not only infringed upon the sovereignty of other nations and undermined democratic systems, they also put diaspora communities under a panopticon, with the result that they live in constant fear.

The IPAC statement called on the world’s democracies to take decisive action to defend their national sovereignty and safeguard the fundamental rights of all their residents. It further stressed that by openly engaging those who China sought to silence or isolate, including Taiwan government officials, democratic nations were taking concrete action to enhance democratic resilience and national sovereignty.

MOFA affirms the work of IPAC and like-minded partners, including Safeguard Defenders, to take concrete action to show collective concern about China’s authoritarian expansion, including the call for the democratic alliance to enhance cooperation with Taiwan in opposing China’s transnational repression.

The ROC (Taiwan) will continue to enhance its partnerships with like-minded nations and, through information exchange and related mechanisms, defend against transnational repression. Taiwan reiterates the need for democratic nations to work together. This will effectively halt authoritarian violence and ensure the right of people to live free from fear.
